doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Opening and the McBrides' birthplaces and dates
summary: Allen opens the tape and asks where each was born. Billy was born in Mobile, Alabama, on 26 February 1884, a Mardi Gras day; Mary in Algiers, New Orleans, on 28 July 1891.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: 된 smack and mac. Yes. And where were you born? Can you tell? Oh, I was born in Mobile, Alabama in the year of 1884. You have the exact date, if you don't mind. February the 26th. Nice to have

that, too. It happened to be on a Mardi Gras day. Oh, Mardi Gras day. They have quite a Mardi Gras in Mobile, too. In Mobile, yes. Pensacola also. And this is McBride. Where were you born? In Algiers,
Louisiana. That's West New Orleans. On July the 28th, 1891. That makes me 68 this birthday.
